page.title: Your smart band
page.desc: What the band measures, in real time. Readings reach the same system as manual entry.
watch.title: Band watch face
watch.aria: Band: heart rate {{fc}} bpm, SpO₂ {{spo2}} %, {{hoy}} of 5 vital signs logged today
watch.note: The rings use a display scale (not clinical): pulse 40 to 180 bpm, SpO₂ 70 to 100 %, and today's signs 0 to 5.
sim.title: Live simulated mission
sim.desc: The crew's bands send on their own: CO₂ rises, the crew gets worse, the link is lost and comes back. It uses the same channel as a real band; only the values are made up.
story.title: Mission story
story.empty: Start the mission to see the story.
streak.title: Measurement streak
streak.todayDone: You logged all 5 signs today. No pressure: come back whenever you like tomorrow.
streak.todayMissing: To complete today you still need: {{lista}}.
